execution: Step wide to the side, toes forward
Sit your hips back over that foot
Keep the other leg long and straight
Push off the bent leg to step back in
faults: Don't let the bent knee cave in
Don't lift the heel of the bent leg
Don't step so wide that you can't push back

notes: Choose a step width where the bent knee tracks over the foot. Stepping too wide pulls the knee out of line; shorten the step if it does.
Go only as deep as your inner thigh allows with a flat back.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: A sharp pull in the groin
Pain that changes how you move

regressions.name: Shallow lateral lunge
regressions.reason: A shorter step and less depth while range and balance build.

regressions.name: Lateral lunge holding a support
regressions.reason: A hand on a rack or bench helps balance.

progressions.name: Goblet lateral lunge
progressions.reason: One dumbbell or kettlebell held at the chest adds load. Logged with the weight held.

progressions.name: Cossack squat
progressions.reason: Deeper side-to-side squat with the straight leg's toes up; needs more hip range.

substitutions.name: Hip adduction machine
substitutions.reason: Inner-thigh work on a stack, no balance needed.

substitutions.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
substitutions.reason: Single-leg work in a forward-back line instead of side to side.

guideBrief.cameraNote: Front view at hip height so the side step, the bent knee over the foot and the straight trailing leg are all visible.

keyPositions.label: Standing
keyPositions.describe: Standing tall, feet hip-width, hands together at the chest.

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: One foot has stepped wide to the side, toes forward, heel down. That knee bent over the foot, hips sitting back over it, chest up with a slight forward lean. The other leg straight, foot flat.

ikHints: Both feet flat on the floor at the bottom
Bent knee stays over the second toe
emphasise: Hips sit back over the stepping foot
Bent knee in line with the foot
